dedupe_keys.name: supporting data and detailed formulation for co planning of integrated ac electricity and gas systems under n 1 reliability using a progressive contingency screening framework

description: Isfahan University of Technology and collaborating researchers publish test inputs and a mathematical formulation for electricity-gas infrastructure co-planning. Zenodo supplies an Excel workbook, README and formulation PDF free under CC BY 4.0. Cases couple the Garver electric network to a seven-node gas network and an IEEE 118-bus grid to a larger gas test system. Inputs cover existing and candidate assets, generation, demand, coupling and contingencies, with reported results. These materials can benchmark investment and N-1 reliability simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this paired case package. Coverage is numerical test systems, and the describing manuscript is identified as submitted, not accepted. There is no executable optimisation code; users must implement the formulation. Solver choices, feasibility and global optimality remain unverified. No workbook or PDF was downloaded.
